tools.name: regaffairs_get_answer_status
tools.description: Fetches the result of a `regaffairs_ask_question` call that returned `status: "running"` and an `answer_id`. It waits up to 40 seconds and returns the finished answer with citations, or `running` again. It does not count as a new question. Not intended for starting a new question.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "regaffairs_list_covered_regulations" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Lists what RegAffairs AI covers ("do you have the EU Cosmetics Regulation?", "which Brazil pesticide registers are in?", "what do you cover for food in the UK?"…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: regaffairs_check_food_additive_or_ingredient, regaffairs_check_pesticide_approval_and_mrl · Private data: regaffairs_ask_question, regaffairs_search_regulations, regaffairs_get_workplace_exposure_limits, regaffairs_check_food_additive_or_ingredient, regaffairs_find_pharma_gmp_and_ich_guidance, regaffairs_check_drug_or_device_approval · Public sink: regaffairs_ask_question.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: regaffairs_check_food_additive_or_ingredient, regaffairs_check_pesticide_approval_and_mrl · Private data: regaffairs_ask_question, regaffairs_search_regulations, regaffairs_get_workplace_exposure_limits, regaffairs_check_food_additive_or_ingredient, regaffairs_find_pharma_gmp_and_ich_guidance, regaffairs_check_drug_or_device_approval · Public sink: regaffairs_ask_question

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
